messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT · routing-service · high error rate detected in europe-west • fallback loops observed :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for team: eng-sre • severity: P1 • runbook: /runbooks/routing-fallback-loop • thread: 2052468101
sana: seeing huge spike in 5xxs around 03:12 UTC, most requests get redirected between model-variant A -> B -> A repeatedly.
marco: noted, is this after the schema migration that went out at 03:00? saw PR that removed `legacyFallback` from schema last night.
raj (oncall-sre): i'm paged, jumping in. can someone paste the routing logs for a single request id?
emily: plucking a sample from logs: `req=tx-8f3b2 route_choice=eu-west->fallback(region=us-west)->eu-west attempt=4 error=incompatible-model-variant`
marco: that 'fallback(region=us-west)' is weird — routing policy should prefer regional fallback then degrade to compatible model variant, not bounce region+variant.
jamie-cs: we have 4 customers in eu-west reporting latency spikes and 10% error rate on embedding endpoints. cs escalations incoming.
raj (oncall-sre): status check: is autoscaler spinning up cross-region nodes? could be policy triggering region fallback when variant mismatch occurs.
sana: quick grep of configstore for recent migration shows old policy key `default_fallback` still present in some services:

```
# legacy config snippet
default_fallback: {
  strategy: "regional-first",
  legacyFallback: true,
  fallback_model: "redwood-legacy-v1"
}
```

marco: new schema renamed `legacyFallback` -> `compat_mode` and default behavior flipped to false. services that didn't pick up the new schema are treating the presence of the deprecated field as truthy and using the legacy behavior — hence region+variant oscillation.
raj (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation: can we push a hotfix to the routing service to ignore deprecated fields OR add a fail-safe that prevents cross-region fallback within 2 retries?
emily: i can push a small change to reject deprecated field at validation layer; but that'll require a deploy. propose rollback of schema migration first to stop new configs being served. deploy-bot: queued rollback job #12781 (waiting for approval)
marco: rollback + patch sounds right. also set a temporary routing guard to stop cross-region fallbacks: add `max_region_hops: 0` for active routes in configstore (can be done via CLI).
raj (oncall-sre): @emily do it — do the rollback and open CLI change for `max_region_hops: 0`. i'll coordinate traffic steering.
emily: rolling rollback now — command: `k8s-deploy --namespace=routing config-migration rollback v2025-03-21`
ops-bot: deploy started by emily • pod restarts: routing-service-3 -> routing-service-4 • ETA ~2m
deploy-bot: rollback job #12781 approved by emily • status: in_progress -> success
ops-bot: rollback completed, new config timestamp: 2052469402 • purged migrated schema from configstore for eu-west services
marco: pushed temporary KV: `routes.euwest.max_region_hops=0` — propagated to routers. monitoring shows region hop counts dropping.
raj (oncall-sre): traffic is stabilizing. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 1.4% over the last 6 mins.
jamie-cs: updating customers on impacted customers list. sending interim note: "We identified a routing config issue after a schema migration; we've deployed a rollback and mitigation; service is recovering."
product-mike: is there user-facing data loss? any requests dropped or inconsistent completions?
marco: no data loss, some requests hit model-variant mismatches and returned 5xx; no persisted state affected.
raj (oncall-sre): still keeping incident P1 until stable for 1 hour. next steps: root cause analysis, permanent schema migration plan, stricter validation to reject deprecated fields at ingest, and a canary check to detect mismatch loops.
emily: I'll open PR for validation + a lint rule in config CI to fail builds that include deprecated keys.
marco: i'll add a runtime guard: if route oscillation detected >3 attempts in 30s, circuit-break route and fallback to nearest compatible model only.
jamie-cs: CS will send customer follow-up email once we have the postmortem draft.
incident-bot: ACTIONS CREATED • ticket: https://jira.internal/RINF-4321 • owner: raj (oncall-sre) • severity: P1 • runbook: /runbooks/routing-fallback-loop
raj (oncall-sre): handing off to sprint oncall at 05:00 UTC — @marco you own follow-ups until then, i'll update the pager and leave the channel.
marco: ack, will own postmortem and follow-ups.
jamie-cs: thanks team, keeping cs thread updated :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED · routing-service errors returned to normal • final 5xx peak: 12% -> stabilized <1.5% • duration ~32 minutes • thread closed at 2052471701
